item.title: 72 Hr Contest Round 1
item.content:encoded:
This is my entry for the 72 hr contest Part 1: the Murder Mystery. Like a lot of other entries, this will be a coldpost.

+ show block
– hide block

Normally, in most murder mysteries, the murder will be covered as a suicide.

Here, the Factory wants the suicide to be covered as a murder. And it forces its employees (and some random outsider) to play their roles well. While profiting off in the cultural industry via documentary films of the Factory's investigative prowess.

And why the Chaos Insurgency? They're the obligatory antagonists, antagonists for antagonist's sake. The most optimal GoI for the duty of a scapegoat, I believe.
